What's your return and refund policy?
Our return and refund policy is outlined in our 30-Day Return Policy.
Return policy
Returns are accepted for a replacement or refund.
This policy applies exclusively to orders placed on NANUK.com.
It does not apply to wholesale orders or purchases from third-party websites.
The product must be in perfect condition.
Returns must be authorized by us in advance, and a Return Authorization must be issued before the item is shipped back.
Return shipping
Return shipping is generally paid by the buyer.
If the return is due to an error on our side, we cover the shipping.
Refunds
All returns are inspected at our warehouse before a refund is issued.
Refunds are processed to your original method of payment.
How to start a return
Submit your request through our returns portal using the Start a Return process on our website.
